import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector
random.seed(146)
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

def mat(name, color, rough=.65):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.diffuse_color=(*color,1); m.use_nodes=True
    m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF'].inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*color,1)
    m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF'].inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough
    return m
sand=mat('Warm limestone',(.61,.51,.37)); edge=mat('Cut stone edges',(.78,.70,.55))
wood=mat('Oiled cedar seating',(.30,.14,.065)); grass=mat('Meadow turf',(.22,.32,.105))
soil=mat('Mulched planting beds',(.15,.095,.055)); leaf=mat('Olive foliage',(.19,.29,.11))
trunk=mat('Tree bark',(.22,.13,.075)); metal=mat('Dark bronze rails',(.10,.12,.10),.35)

def cube(name, loc, scale, material, bevel=0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.dimensions=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True); o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel:
        m=o.modifiers.new('Soft edges','BEVEL'); m.width=bevel; m.segments=2
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def beam(name,a,b,r,material):
    d=Vector(b)-Vector(a); bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=12, radius=r, depth=d.length, location=(Vector(a)+Vector(b))/2)
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.rotation_euler=d.to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); o.data.materials.append(material); return o

def sector(name, ri, ro, z0, z1, a0, a1, material):
    n=max(2,int(abs(a1-a0)/2)); verts=[]
    for z in (z0,z1):
        for r in (ri,ro):
            verts.extend([(r*math.cos(math.radians(a0+(a1-a0)*i/n)),r*math.sin(math.radians(a0+(a1-a0)*i/n)),z) for i in range(n+1)])
    k=n+1; faces=[]
    for i in range(n):
        faces.extend([(i,i+1,k+i+1,k+i),(2*k+i,3*k+i,3*k+i+1,2*k+i+1),(i,2*k+i,2*k+i+1,i+1),(k+i,k+i+1,3*k+i+1,3*k+i)])
    faces.extend([(0,k,3*k,2*k),(n,2*k+n,3*k+n,k+n)])
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); me.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); me.update(); o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); o.data.materials.append(material); return o

cube('Landscape plinth',(0,3,-.42),(37,31,.8),grass,.3)
# Bowl opens toward the foreground; broad radial aisles separate the seating banks.
banks=[(0,18),(25,155),(162,180)]
for row in range(7):
    ri=5+row*1.35; ro=ri+1.35; top=.22+row*.53
    for a,b in banks:
        sector('Terrace %02d foundation'%row,ri,ro,-.02,top,a,b,sand)
        sector('Terrace %02d stone nosing'%row,ri,ri+.14,top,top+.07,a,b,edge)
        # Individual curved bench boards with visible joint gaps.
        count=max(1,int((b-a)/7))
        for j in range(count):
            aa=a+(b-a)*j/count+.20; bb=a+(b-a)*(j+1)/count-.20
            sector('Cedar bench board',ri+.22,ri+.68,top+.35,top+.45,aa,bb,wood)
        for angle in range(int(a)+3,int(b),12):
            t=math.radians(angle)
            cube('Bench support',((ri+.44)*math.cos(t),(ri+.44)*math.sin(t),top+.17),(.18,.20,.34),metal)
# Two side-access stair flights, two steps per terrace rise.
for a,b in [(18,25),(155,162)]:
    for i in range(14):
        ri=5+i*.675; top=.22+i*.265
        sector('Side access stair tread',ri,ri+.675,-.02,top,a,b,edge)
    for angle in (a+.6,b-.6):
        t=math.radians(angle); pts=[]
        for i in range(0,15,2):
            r=5+i*.675; z=.22+i*.265+.95
            p=(r*math.cos(t),r*math.sin(t),z); pts.append(p)
            beam('Aisle handrail post',(p[0],p[1],z-.95),p,.035,metal)
        for p,q in zip(pts,pts[1:]): beam('Sloping aisle handrail',p,q,.045,metal)
sector('Upper promenade',14.45,16.05,-.02,3.42,0,180,sand)
sector('Upper planting strip',16.1,17.1,-.02,.13,0,180,soil)
# Low stage and its accessible front apron.
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=96, radius=4.45, depth=.30, location=(0,.55,.12)); bpy.context.object.name='Circular performance stage'; bpy.context.object.data.materials.append(edge)
cube('Stage approach',(0,-4.3,.02),(7,2,.12),sand,.06)
for x in (-3.6,3.6):
    cube('Stage planter',(x,-3.2,.32),(1.1,.8,.65),sand,.08)
    for j in range(5):
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_ico_sphere_add(subdivisions=1,radius=.29,location=(x+random.uniform(-.3,.3),-3.2+random.uniform(-.15,.15),.82)); bpy.context.object.data.materials.append(leaf)
for angle in range(8,178,14):
    t=math.radians(angle); x,y=16.6*math.cos(t),16.6*math.sin(t)
    beam('Tree trunk',(x,y,0),(x,y,2.4),.13,trunk)
    for j in range(3):
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_ico_sphere_add(subdivisions=2,radius=1.0,location=(x+random.uniform(-.45,.45),y+random.uniform(-.4,.4),2.5+j*.35))
        o=bpy.context.object; o.name='Sculpted olive canopy'; o.scale=(1,.9,.85); o.data.materials.append(leaf)
for x in (-14.5,14.5):
    for y in (-3,-.6):
        cube('Approach bollard',(x,y,.5),(.16,.16,1),metal,.025)
        cube('Bollard light lens',(x,y,.88),(.18,.18,.12),edge,.015)
# Retaining-wall end caps expose the rising profile at either side.
for side in (-1,1):
    for i in range(7):
        cube('Terrace end coping',(side*(5.67+i*1.35),-.08,.28+i*.53),(1.34,.23,.12),edge,.025)
scene=bpy.context.scene; scene.render.engine='CYCLES'; scene.cycles.samples=64
scene.world.color=(.35,.35,.35)
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA', location=(1,-8,22)); bpy.context.object.data.energy=2600; bpy.context.object.data.shape='DISK'; bpy.context.object.data.size=13
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN', location=(-10,-10,20)); bpy.context.object.rotation_euler=(.45,-.35,-.5); bpy.context.object.data.energy=2.2; bpy.context.object.data.angle=.18
bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(25,-30,25)); cam=bpy.context.object; cam.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,5,1))-cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler(); cam.data.type='ORTHO'; cam.data.ortho_scale=43; scene.camera=cam
scene.render.resolution_x=1500; scene.render.resolution_y=1100; scene.render.resolution_percentage=100

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT'); bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

def mat(name,c,metal=0,rough=.5):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.diffuse_color=(*c,1); m.use_nodes=True; p=m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']; p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*c,1); p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal; p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough; return m
concrete=mat('Warm ivory concrete',(.66,.67,.63)); steel=mat('Graphite structure',(.07,.10,.12),.65,.3); silver=mat('Platform galvanized steel',(.45,.52,.55),.7,.32)
glass=mat('Blue cab glazing',(.12,.34,.42),.20,.17); glass.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF'].inputs['Transmission Weight'].default_value=.38
roof=mat('Roof enamel',(.75,.77,.72),.45,.3); yellow=mat('Safety yellow',(.95,.58,.06)); asphalt=mat('Apron',(.18,.21,.22)); grass=mat('Airfield grass',(.28,.36,.17)); red=mat('Beacon red',(.7,.015,.01))
red.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF'].inputs['Emission Color'].default_value=(1,.025,.01,1); red.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF'].inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value=3

def box(name,loc,size,m,bev=0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.dimensions=size; bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True); o.data.materials.append(m)
    if bev:
        b=o.modifiers.new('Edge bevel','BEVEL'); b.width=bev; b.segments=2; o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def cyl(name,loc,r,depth,m,n=48,r2=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=n,radius1=r,radius2=r if r2 is None else r2,depth=depth,location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.data.materials.append(m); return o

def beam(name,a,b,r,m):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b); o=cyl(name,(a+b)/2,r,(b-a).length,m,12); o.rotation_euler=(b-a).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); return o

def ring(name,ri,ro,z,thick,m,n=64):
    vs=[]
    for zz in (z-thick,z):
        for r in (ri,ro): vs.extend([(r*math.cos(i*math.tau/n),r*math.sin(i*math.tau/n),zz) for i in range(n)])
    fs=[]
    for i in range(n):
        j=(i+1)%n; fs.extend([(i,j,n+j,n+i),(2*n+i,3*n+i,3*n+j,2*n+j),(i,2*n+i,2*n+j,j),(n+i,n+j,3*n+j,3*n+i)])
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); me.from_pydata(vs,[],fs); me.update(); o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); o.data.materials.append(m)

def rail(radius,z):
    for i in range(24):
        t=i*math.tau/24; x,y=radius*math.cos(t),radius*math.sin(t); beam('Platform railing post',(x,y,z),(x,y,z+1.05),.035,silver)
        t2=(i+1)*math.tau/24
        for dz in (.5,1.05): beam('Platform perimeter rail',(x,y,z+dz),(radius*math.cos(t2),radius*math.sin(t2),z+dz),.028,silver)

box('Airfield base',(0,0,-.32),(28,26,.6),grass,.2); box('Service apron',(0,0,.015),(17,17,.08),asphalt,.15)
box('Tower foundation',(0,0,.22),(5.6,5.6,.4),concrete,.10)
cyl('Tapered octagonal tower shaft',(0,0,6.05),2.15,11.7,concrete,8,1.70)
# Narrow service windows on the front shaft face, set outward from the octagonal skin.
for z in (3.0,5.7,8.4):
    box('Window surround',(0,-1.94+(z-3)*.035,z),(.7,.14,1.30),steel,.045)
    box('Shaft window',(0,-2.02+(z-3)*.035,z),(.51,.05,1.08),glass,.025)
box('Ground service annex',(3.2,1.25,1.5),(3.6,4.7,3),concrete,.10); box('Annex roof coping',(3.2,1.25,3.06),(3.85,4.95,.18),roof,.055)
box('Entry door',(3.3,-1.12,1.15),(1.15,.11,2.3),steel,.025)
box('Door vision panel',(3.3,-1.19,1.52),(.72,.04,.69),glass,.015)
for i in range(9): box('Annex ventilation louver',(5.025,.8,1+i*.115),(.08,1.5,.045),silver)
# Lower mechanical service platform and upper cab catwalk.
ring('Mechanical service platform',1.65,2.85,8.7,.20,silver); rail(2.8,8.7)
ring('Cab exterior catwalk',1.55,3.72,11.6,.24,silver); rail(3.65,11.6)
for i in range(8):
    t=i*math.tau/8
    beam('Catwalk diagonal support',(1.6*math.cos(t),1.6*math.sin(t),10.15),(3.35*math.cos(t),3.35*math.sin(t),11.38),.075,steel)
cyl('Cab lower solid drum',(0,0,11.95),2.67,.70,steel,8,2.79)
# Splayed panoramic glazing, each pane is a solid mesh panel.
n=8; offset=math.pi/8
for i in range(n):
    a=offset+i*math.tau/n; b=offset+(i+1)*math.tau/n
    vs=[(2.79*math.cos(a),2.79*math.sin(a),12.3),(2.79*math.cos(b),2.79*math.sin(b),12.3),(3.13*math.cos(b),3.13*math.sin(b),14.45),(3.13*math.cos(a),3.13*math.sin(a),14.45)]
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new('Cab pane'); me.from_pydata(vs,[],[(0,1,2,3)]); me.update(); o=bpy.data.objects.new('Panoramic glazed cab panel',me); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); o.data.materials.append(glass); s=o.modifiers.new('Glazing thickness','SOLIDIFY'); s.thickness=.035
    beam('Sloping cab mullion',vs[0],vs[3],.065,steel)
    beam('Window lower frame',vs[0],vs[1],.06,steel); beam('Window upper frame',vs[3],vs[2],.06,steel)
    p=Vector(vs[0]).lerp(Vector(vs[1]),.5); q=Vector(vs[3]).lerp(Vector(vs[2]),.5); beam('Fine intermediate mullion',p,q,.025,silver)
cyl('Broad octagonal roof',(0,0,14.57),3.58,.25,roof,8,3.58)
cyl('Roof raised cap',(0,0,14.80),2.6,.22,steel,8,2.5)
# Interior consoles and operator seats are visible through the glazing.
for x in (-1.2,0,1.2):
    box('Control console',(x,-1.25,12.65),(.95,.65,.7),steel,.07)
    o=box('Radar display',(x,-1.35,13.13),(.68,.12,.43),glass,.025); o.rotation_euler[0]=-.25
    cyl('Operator stool',(x,-.3,12.8),.28,.12,steel,24); beam('Stool stem',(x,-.3,12.2),(x,-.3,12.75),.05,silver)
# Ladder on the rear of the shaft, connecting service levels.
for x in (-.35,.35): beam('Service ladder rail',(x,2.05,3.2),(x,2.05,11.7),.045,steel)
for i in range(28): beam('Ladder rung',(-.35,2.05,3.3+i*.3),(.35,2.05,3.3+i*.3),.03,silver)
beam('Roof antenna mast',(0,0,14.9),(0,0,18),.065,silver)
for z in (16.1,16.5,16.9): beam('Radio antenna cross element',(-.65,0,z),(.65,0,z),.022,silver)
cyl('Obstruction beacon',(0,0,18.08),.13,.22,red,24)
beam('Secondary aerial',(1.35,.5,14.85),(1.35,.5,16.6),.035,silver)
for x in (-5.8,5.8):
    for y in (-5,-3,-1): cyl('Safety bollard',(x,y,.5),.10,1,yellow,16)
scene=bpy.context.scene; scene.render.engine='CYCLES'; scene.cycles.samples=64; scene.world.color=(.34,.38,.42)
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA',location=(5,-10,22)); bpy.context.object.data.energy=2400; bpy.context.object.data.size=10
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN'); bpy.context.object.rotation_euler=(.4,-.5,-.4); bpy.context.object.data.energy=2.3; bpy.context.object.data.angle=.12
bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(24,-31,22)); cam=bpy.context.object; cam.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,0,8.2))-cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler(); cam.data.type='ORTHO'; cam.data.ortho_scale=26; scene.camera=cam
scene.render.resolution_x=1200; scene.render.resolution_y=1500; scene.render.resolution_percentage=100

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT'); bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

def mat(name,c,metal=0,rough=.55):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.diffuse_color=(*c,1); m.use_nodes=True; p=m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']; p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*c,1); p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal; p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough; return m
steel=mat('Deep teal bridge steel',(.035,.21,.23),.7,.3); silver=mat('Stainless hardware',(.52,.58,.58),.8,.25); deck=mat('Warm timber decking',(.43,.29,.16)); concrete=mat('Abutment concrete',(.57,.56,.49)); roof=mat('Portal folded metal roof',(.71,.39,.13),.6,.34)
land=mat('Grassed banks',(.28,.36,.16)); water=mat('River water',(.08,.27,.29),.3,.22); path=mat('Approach gravel',(.52,.48,.38)); dark=mat('Portal sign background',(.055,.10,.11)); white=mat('Sign lettering',(.87,.88,.77))

def box(name,loc,size,m,bev=0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.dimensions=size; bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True); o.data.materials.append(m)
    if bev:
        b=o.modifiers.new('Fabrication edge radius','BEVEL'); b.width=bev; b.segments=2; o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def beam(name,a,b,w,d,m):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b); o=box(name,(a+b)/2,(w,d,(b-a).length),m,.012); o.rotation_euler=(b-a).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); return o

def bolt(name,loc,axis='Y'):
    rot=(math.pi/2,0,0) if axis=='Y' else (0,0,0)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=6,radius=.049,depth=.045,location=loc,rotation=rot); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.data.materials.append(silver)

def panel(name,verts,faces,m,thickness=.06):
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); me.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); me.update(); o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); o.data.materials.append(m); s=o.modifiers.new('Sheet thickness','SOLIDIFY'); s.thickness=thickness; return o

box('River bed',(0,0,-1.1),(38,26,.4),concrete)
box('River surface',(0,0,-.65),(20.7,26,.08),water)
for side in (-1,1):
    box('Raised landscaped bank',(side*15.8,0,-.17),(10.7,26,1.55),land,.25)
    box('Approach path',(side*16.2,0,.64),(10,3.4,.08),path,.03)
    box('Concrete bridge abutment',(side*10.5,0,.35),(1.7,5.6,1.75),concrete,.09)
    box('Abutment bearing ledge',(side*10.35,0,1.16),(1.9,5.8,.22),concrete,.045)
    for y in (-1.9,1.9):
        box('Elastomer bearing pad',(side*10.4,y,1.33),(.52,.44,.14),dark,.025)
        box('Steel bearing plate',(side*10.4,y,1.43),(.68,.55,.06),silver,.012)
# Six repeating 3.5 m truss modules over a clear river span.
for y in (-1.92,1.92):
    for j in range(6):
        xa=-10.5+j*3.5; xb=xa+3.5
        beam('Module lower chord',(xa,y,1.59),(xb,y,1.59),.20,.23,steel)
        beam('Module upper chord',(xa,y,4.29),(xb,y,4.29),.18,.20,steel)
        beam('Warren truss rising diagonal',(xa,y,1.59),((xa+xb)/2,y,4.29),.15,.17,steel)
        beam('Warren truss falling diagonal',((xa+xb)/2,y,4.29),(xb,y,1.59),.15,.17,steel)
        # Bolted gusset plates explicitly mark the modular connections.
        for x,z in ((xa,1.59),((xa+xb)/2,4.29)):
            outward=y+(.135 if y>0 else -.135)
            panel('Triangular connection gusset',[(x-.24,outward,z-.15),(x+.24,outward,z-.15),(x,outward,z+.27)],[(0,1,2)],steel,.035)
            for dx,dz in ((-.11,-.065),(.11,-.065),(0,.13)): bolt('Gusset hex bolt',(x+dx,outward+(.04 if y>0 else -.04),z+dz))
    for j in range(7):
        x=-10.5+j*3.5
        beam('Module boundary upright',(x,y,1.59),(x,y,4.29),.13,.15,steel)
        box('Chord splice plate',(x,y+(.145 if y>0 else -.145),4.29),(.55,.05,.28),silver,.015)
        for dx in (-.19,.19): bolt('Splice bolt',(x+dx,y+(.18 if y>0 else -.18),4.29))
# Cross girders and bracing below the pedestrian deck.
for j in range(13):
    x=-10.5+j*1.75
    beam('Deck transverse floor beam',(x,-2.02,1.49),(x,2.02,1.49),.14,.23,steel)
for j in range(6):
    x=-10.5+j*3.5
    beam('Under deck cross brace A',(x,-1.85,1.34),(x+3.5,1.85,1.34),.055,.065,silver)
    beam('Under deck cross brace B',(x,1.85,1.34),(x+3.5,-1.85,1.34),.055,.065,silver)
for i in range(120): box('Deck transverse timber board',(-10.42+i*.175,0,1.77),(.163,3.6,.15),deck,.009)
# Closely spaced pedestrian balusters inside the structural trusses.
for y in (-1.72,1.72):
    beam('Continuous pedestrian handrail',(-10.5,y,2.95),(10.5,y,2.95),.075,.075,silver)
    beam('Guard lower rail',(-10.5,y,1.96),(10.5,y,1.96),.055,.055,steel)
    for i in range(151):
        x=-10.5+i*.14; beam('Slender guard baluster',(x,y,1.96),(x,y,2.91),.025,.025,steel)
# Covered entry portals stand on both abutments, with pitched angular roofs.
for side in (-1,1):
    cx=side*11.45
    box('Portal entry landing',(cx,0,1.69),(2.0,3.7,.30),deck,.025)
    for x in (cx-1,cx+1):
        for y in (-2.22,2.22):
            box('Portal column',(x,y,3.1),(.19,.19,3.4),steel,.02)
            box('Portal base plate',(x,y,1.45),(.40,.40,.08),silver,.018)
            for dx in (-.13,.13):
                for dy in (-.13,.13): bolt('Anchor bolt',(x+dx,y+dy,1.51),'Z')
        beam('Portal left roof rafter',(x,-2.65,4.65),(x,0,5.48),.16,.20,steel)
        beam('Portal right roof rafter',(x,0,5.48),(x,2.65,4.65),.16,.20,steel)
        for y in (-2.22,2.22): beam('Portal knee brace',(x,y,3.95),(x,y*.64,4.87),.10,.12,steel)
    verts=[(cx-1.35,-2.75,4.70),(cx+1.35,-2.75,4.70),(cx+1.35,0,5.55),(cx-1.35,0,5.55),(cx-1.35,2.75,4.70),(cx+1.35,2.75,4.70)]
    panel('Portal folded canopy',verts,[(0,1,2,3),(3,2,5,4)],roof,.09)
    for y in (-2.65,0,2.65):
